en.empty: Nothing matched. Try a capability — memory, vision, terminal. Only install-tested plugins are listed here; the full catalogue is on dshmarketplace.dev.
en.needsAllowBuilds: This plugin installs from GitHub, and pnpm blocks a git-hosted package's build script until you allow it. Run the install once in a terminal — `dsh plugin --profile web add <source>` — and pnpm prints the exact key to add under `allowBuilds` in ~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml. Plugins published to npm install here without that step.
en.riskNote: Plugins run with your agent's permissions. Detection is heuristic — an empty list is not a clean bill of health.
